subtitle: One-on-one notes your AI writes up after each meeting.
about: A running note for meetings with one person, with topics for next time, follow-ups and past conversations. Add topics yourself during the week, then tell your AI how the meeting went to write it up.

ask.prompt: Set up the one-on-one notes template in my Pinto Notes.

slides.label: Write up a 1:1
slides.you: Emma and I just had our 1:1. On-call was rough, and she wants to lead the spring launch.
slides.ai: Wrote it up under Past 1:1s and added what each of you promised to Follow-ups.
slides.alt: 1:1 notes filled in, in Pinto Notes on a Mac

slides.label: Add a topic
slides.you: Add the conference budget for next time.

slides.label: Use it yourself
slides.note: Or tick and edit it yourself.
